group_key: Complete validated dashed accession only; submission reference identity, not economic Event or entity identity
structural_requirements: Reuse v1 literal-path/index validation: exact SEC Archives relative submission path, index CIK numerically agrees with path CIK, filename accession agrees with group key, valid raw filed date no later than index day; preserve all raw values
retention: Every physical source row and original position, raw line/date/name/CIK/path; exact duplicate multiplicity and distinct reference variants; no canonical identity merge or extra independent signal
conflicts: Retain and reject incompatible groups with explicit reasons. Any critical group conflict blocks the entire index first-four proposal; never skip a difficult group to fill four slots. Malformed/unsafe index structures fail explicitly.
locator_proposal: At most one address per compatible group: lowest numeric index CIK, then literal filename; no name/role/body/yield/identity/outcome input. This is a proposed capture address, not issuer or proof of alias-byte equivalence.
first_four_proposal: Only if no critical conflicts: first four distinct exact Form4 accession groups in ascending accession order, or all if fewer. No amendments/other forms. Proposed future candidates only; all bodies remain unacquired and unauthorized.
later_body_requirements: Separate authorization required. Existing parser must validate body/header accession/form/official date and derive issuer/owners independently. Multiple captured variants with contradictory bytes require explicit version/conflict handling, never last-write-wins.
v1_compatibility: Offline reinterpretation of pinned original evidence only. Do not amend v1 declaration, receipt, stop reason, raw bytes, parser/rejection or prior results. September11 stays unattempted/unknown. No v2 acquisition or request chronology is created.
